candidates.review_note: Flatten the prescribed route to nonnegative damage prefix sums. For any fixed potion order, delaying a potion until the next step would kill the agent cannot decrease survivability and can only reduce cap-related healing waste. For each used-potion subset keep the maximum effective energy, defined as current health plus damage already traversed. It determines the farthest surviving route prefix by strict inequality prefix_damage < energy; zero health is death. At that boundary, try each unused potion, applying HPmax before the next move. Repeated potion additions at the same boundary model drinking several at once. Higher energy for an identical subset dominates lower energy because both its current reach and the delayed cap threshold are monotone. The finite subset DP covers every potion order without assuming unlimited supplies, and an empty or all-zero-damage route succeeds immediately.
